blocks.value: **`Scanner`** is a class in the `java.util` package. Its methods read data from the standard input device and store that data into variables.
**Step 2: create a Scanner object connected to the keyboard:**

items: `Scanner input` declares an object of `Scanner` type named `input`. The object name is yours to choose, `input`, `sc`, and `keyboard` are all common.
`new Scanner(System.in)` creates a Scanner object connected to `System.in`, an `InputStream` connected to the standard input device, the keyboard.
